items.title: Russians attack Oldi hypermarket in Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: The Oldi store in Zhytomyr at 9 Vitruka Street has temporarily closed following a Russian attack.

items.title: Zelenskyy to join Norway talks, after which Trump's envoy will fly to Moscow – Axios

items.title: Ukrainische Drohnen attackieren Ölpumpstation in Region Tambow

items.title: Mariupol defender publishes ‘Satan’s Sanatorium’, written with chicken bone on prison garb in captivity
items.teaser: A collection of poems titled “Satan’s Sanatorium” by Andrii Petruk, a serviceman of the 36th Marine Brigade and defender of Mariupol, has been published. He wrote the poems with a chicken bone on prison garb while in Russian captivity.

items.title: Witkoff arrives in Oslo for meeting with Zelenskyy
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff has arrived in Oslo, where he is due to hold talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

items.title: Lithuania’s armed forces chief says patrols on the Kaliningrad border have practically doubled as the troop mission runs into mid-November
items.teaser: Raimundas Vaikšnoras links the deployment to what he calls Russian preparations for a large-scale mobilization, saying Moscow lacks people for Ukraine.

items.title: Three killed and two injured in Russian attack on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Russian attack has targeted Kramatorsk, damaging three multi-story residential buildings and causing multiple civilian casualties.

items.title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces strike Russian military depots, command post
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck a number of Russian military targets on October 19 and overnight into October 20, including logistics depots in the areas of Kripenske in the Luhansk region, Rivnopil in the Donetsk region, and Lahidne in the Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Trump will Selenskyj als Präsidenten weghaben

items.title: Defence forces strike Russian command post, repair unit and warehouses – Ukraine's General Staff

items.title: Power outages in 12 regions after Russian assault on Ukraine's power plants
items.teaser: To avoid overloading previously damaged equipment, power limitation schedules for industry will be applied across all of Ukraine, as well as hourly outage schedules in some regions, Ukrenergo announced.

items.title: An der Front 206 Stürme gemeldet, Russen machen Druck in Richtung Piwdennosloboschansk
items.teaser: An der Front kam es am vergangenen Tag, dem 19. Oktober, zu 206 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Streitkräften und den russischen Besatzern, ließ auf Facebook der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte zur Lage an der Front am Freitag, dem 20. Oktober, melden.

items.title: Kallas calls for moratorium on strikes in Black Sea
items.teaser: EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas has called for increased pressure on Russia and for freedom of navigation to be ensured in the Black Sea.

items.title: Poland considers joint border controls with Ukraine on Polish side of border
items.teaser: The Polish Ministry of Interior has announced readiness to implement joint border operations on Polish territory with Ukraine, pending Schengen notifications and security needs.

items.title: Selenskyj und Witkoff zu Ukraine-Gesprächen in Oslo
items.teaser: Trumps Ton in Richtung Kiew wurde zuletzt rauer, Selenskyj wiederum beklagte einen Mangel an Hilfen. Nun soll es ein Treffen zwischen Selenskyj und Witkoff in Norwegen geben.

items.title: Zelenskyy: In any case, we have more in common than US and Russia do
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine wants to maintain open, pragmatic and honest relations with the United States, stressing that Kyiv and Washington have more in common than Russia and the US.

items.title: Ukraine ready for energy truce if it receives enough interceptor missiles, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine wants to maintain open and honest relations with the United States and is ready for an energy truce, provided it receives enough interceptor missiles to protect its energy infrastructure from Russian attacks.

items.title: Luftabwehr schießt ab/neutralisiert 115 russische Kamikaze-Drohnen
items.teaser: Die Luftverteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben 115 russische Angriffsdrohnen neutralisiert, ließ die Luftwaffe der Streitkräfte der Ukraine im Online-Dienst Telegram melden.

items.title: Power outages reported in 12 regions following Russian attacks
items.teaser: Russian attacks have caused new power outages in 12 regions of Ukraine, while scheduled hourly power cuts affecting up to two groups of consumers are in effect nationwide.

items.title: Ukraine is a partner “in a certain sense” but should stop striking Russian oil refineries, Vance says
items.teaser: U.S. Vice President JD Vance said Ukraine was a partner of the United States “in a certain sense,” but argued that Kyiv should stop striking Russian oil refineries.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Kyiv rush-hour traffic kills at least 1, injures 6

items.teaser: Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre has confirmed that talks involving President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and US President Donald Trump's special envoys will take place in Oslo on 20 October.

items.title: Biletskyi seconded to Center Grouping, retains command of Third Army Corps
items.teaser: The Third Army Corps press service told Ukrinform.

items.teaser: Prosecutors say the men crossed in from Serbia as tourists, set the antennas alight within hours, and left the same night.

items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration is delaying approval for the transfer of Patriot interceptor missiles to Ukraine, which are needed to defend against Russian missile and drone attacks.

items.title: "A wonderful teacher": the woman killed with her baby daughter in Nova Vodolaha
items.teaser: A Russian drone attack on a Kharkiv Oblast park has killed six people, including teacher Inna Mariukhna and her one-year-old daughter Anhelina.

items.title: Drone crashes near petrol station in Kyiv, killing one and injuring six

items.teaser: Tambov Oblast governor Yevgeny Pervyshov said that a Ukrainian drone attack caused a fire 'on the territory of one of the enterprises' in Michurinsky district but did not specify at which facility.

items.title: Interceptors, ballistic missile warnings and Starlink: Zelenskyy details call with Rubio

items.teaser: Volyn Oblast authorities have confirmed overnight attacks targeted civilian and power infrastructure, causing localised power outages and damaging commercial facilities in Kovel.

items.teaser: Seoul has recalled diplomatic personnel from Kyiv, citing Ukraine's failure to resolve disputes over disclosing North Korean POW transfers and ongoing air strike threats.

items.title: Cars catch fire on Kyiv-Odesa highway following Russian drone attack, fatalities and injuries reported
items.teaser: Cars caught fire on the Kyiv-Odesa highway in the Fastiv district of Kyiv region following a Russian drone attack. There are preliminary reports of fatalities and injuries.

items.title: Zelensky, Rubio discuss critical military systems amid US-Ukraine tensions
items.teaser: "I am grateful for his readiness to help and his clear position," President Volodymyr Zelensky said after the conversation.

items.title: War update: 206 clashes on front line in 24 hours as Russian forces step up attacks on Southern Slobozhanskyi axis
items.teaser: A total of 206 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian troops took place along the front line on October 19, with the most reported in the Southern Slobozhanskyi sector.

items.teaser: Oleksandr Hanzha, Head of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast Military Administration, says Russian forces attacked Dnipro on 20 October. The number of people injured and the full extent of the damage remain unclear.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff: 206 combat clashes occur on battlefield, with 26 Russian attacks repelled on South Slobozhanshchyna front
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff reports 206 combat clashes over the past day, with 26 Russian attacks repelled on the South Slobozhanshchyna front and 21 on the Pokrovsk front.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 52 Ortschaften beschossen, ein Zivilist getötet, fünf verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 52 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 848 Mal.

items.title: Russian drone attack damages three energy facilities in Ternopil region
items.teaser: Three energy facilities in the Kremenets district, Ternopil region, were damaged in a Russian drone attack overnight on October 20.

items.title: One killed, five injured as Russian forces launch 848 strikes on Zaporizhzhia region over past day
items.teaser: Russian forces launched 848 attacks on 52 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours. One person was killed and five others injured in enemy strikes on Zaporizhzhia and the Zaporizhzhia district.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, days 1699: Ukraine has liberated more territory than Russia has captured since the start of fall

items.title: Russian attacks damage energy infrastructure in Ternopil and Odesa oblasts, causing power cuts
items.teaser: Overnight Russian attacks on Ternopil and Odesa oblasts damaged energy infrastructure facilities, leaving some areas of Odesa Oblast with power supply disruptions. No casualties have been reported.

items.title: Ukraine's air defence downs 115 out of 165 Russian drones, with 20 still airborne

items.title: Zwei Deutsche verdächtig: Europaweit Fahndung nach Starlink-Anschlag
items.teaser: Zwei Deutsche stehen im Verdacht, einen Brandanschlag auf Starlink-Antennen in Bulgarien verübt zu haben. Nun soll europaweit nach ihnen gefahndet werden.

items.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,560 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 20, 2026, have reached approximately 1,568,720 personnel, including 1,560 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Five injured in overnight Russian attack on Izium – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a series of drone attacks on Izium overnight, damaging houses and the city council’s education department building and sparking four fires.

items.title: Verkehrseinschränkungen in Magdeburg: Diese Straßen werden für den Weihnachtsmarkt gesperrt
items.teaser: Bereits drei Wochen vor dem Magdeburger Weihnachtsmarkt werden rund um den Alten Markt Straßen gesperrt. Die Maßnahmen gehören zum Sicherheitskonzept nach dem Anschlag von 2024.

items.title: 1560 Soldaten - Kampfverluste der Russen am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 20. Oktober 2026 werden auf etwa 1.568720 (+1560 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: Death toll from strike on Kyiv region enterprise rises to three, six injured
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian strike on a production and warehouse building in a community in the Kyiv region's Obukhiv district has risen to three, with six other people injured.

items.title: Witkoff plans Ukraine peace talks in Norway, Putin meeting in Russia
items.teaser: The planned talks with Putin are also expected to address the release of American citizen Stephen Hubbard, who had reportedly been serving with a Ukrainian territorial defense unit in the town of Izium, in Kharkiv Oblast. Hubbard was detained by Russia in 2022.

items.title: Trump open to talks with Putin and Xi on Ukraine without Zelenskyy
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump says he is willing to meet the Russian and Chinese leaders to discuss ending the war in Ukraine, while renewing his criticism of Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

items.title: 11KM-Podcast: Wie Nordkorea den Ukraine-Krieg für seine Zwecke nutzt
items.teaser: Nordkorea rüstet massiv auf. Verhandlungen über das Atomprogramm sind gescheitert. 11KM erzählt davon, wie Machthaber Kim Jong Un den Krieg gegen die Ukraine als historische Chance nutzt.

items.title: Unique evacuation: Kharkiv military hospital tells how wounded soldier was rescued by heavy-lift drone
items.teaser: The Military Medical Clinical Center of the Northern Region in Kharkiv is currently treating a Ukrainian defender who underwent amputations of both legs and was evacuated by air from the Kupiansk sector using a drone.

items.title: Death toll from Russian strike on industrial facility in Kyiv Oblast rises to three
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian attack on a production and storage building in Kyiv Oblast has risen to three. Firefighters have extinguished the fire, but search and rescue operations are continuing.

items.title: Russians strike Zaporizhzhia Oblast 848 times: one killed and five injured
items.teaser: Russian forces have targeted 52 settlements in Zaporizhzhia Oblast with over 600 drones and dozens of airstrikes, damaging homes and infrastructure.

items.title: Trump ready to discuss ending Ukraine war with Putin, Xi
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump has said he is ready to meet with Russian leader Vladimir Putin and Chinese leader Xi Jinping to discuss how to end the war in Ukraine.

items.title: Zelensky awards Order of Merit to Antigua and Barbuda's ambassador to US
items.teaser: Ukraine's Chargé d'Affaires in the United States, Denys Sienik, has presented the Order of Merit, Third Class, to Ronald Sanders, the Ambassador of Antigua and Barbuda to the United States and the country's Permanent Representative to the Organization of American States (OAS).

items.title: Russia loses 1,560 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,560 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Witkoff, Kushner to travel to Norway for talks on peace in Ukraine – Reuters
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner and special envoy Steve Witkoff plan to visit Norway this week for a new round of talks on ending Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: US Vice President Vance states Ukraine should not join NATO
items.teaser: US Vice President JD Vance has emphasised that Washington lacks a formal alliance with Kyiv and urged Ukraine to halt attacks on Russian energy facilities.

items.title: Ukrainians in US to retain temporary protected status for now
items.teaser: Ukrainian and Sudanese refugees will be able to retain Temporary Protected Status (TPS) in the United States for now, despite the status having been set to expire on Monday.

items.title: Moldova denies sending protest note to Ukraine over border guards' Dniester crossing
items.teaser: The two Ukrainian border guards had entered Moldova in a motorboat on Oct. 15 while attempting to detain a Ukrainian man crossing the Dniester River near Holosnita, along the Vinnytsia Oblast border.

items.title: Zelenskyy accuses US of delaying Patriot missile shipment
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has accused the United States of delaying deliveries of air defense missiles already paid for by European allies, as relations between Washington and Kyiv deteriorate.

items.title: Ukrainians in Moldova take part in National Forum of Ethnic Minorities
items.teaser: Representatives of the National Congress of Ukrainians of Moldova (NCUM), led by Dmytro Lekartsev, took part in the ethnic minorities forum “Different Voices – A Shared Future,” which brought together around 210 participants.

items.title: Russian drone hits apartment block in Sumy, causing fire

items.title: Verbaler Schlagabtausch: Spannungen zwischen Trump und Selenskyj
items.teaser: US-Präsident Trump verschärft den Ton gegenüber der Ukraine und Selenskyj immer weiter. Der kritisiert die verzögerte Lieferung von bereits bezahlten Abwehrraketen.

items.title: Government directs UAH 3.8 bln toward regional resilience plans
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has allocated UAH 3.77 billion from the state budget to implement comprehensive resilience plans for regions and selected cities.

items.title: SSU detains woman in Odesa suspected of directing Russian strikes on port and National Guard facilities
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has detained a sales representative of a food company in Odesa who, according to investigators, was gathering intelligence on Ukrainian National Guard locations, oil-refining facilities and port infrastructure at the direction of Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB).

items.title: Russians attack church and business in Khmelnytskyi Oblast
items.teaser: A church in the Shepetivka district sustained damage to its facade, windows and bell tower during a Russian attack. A local business was also targeted, with no casualties reported so far.

items.title: Trump zeigt sich offen für Gipfel mit Putin und Xi
items.teaser: US-Präsident Trump signalisiert Bereitschaft zu einem möglichen Dreiergipfel im November in China. Die Ukraine soll nicht dran teilnehmen - und kritisiert ihren Ausschluss scharf.

items.title: Zelensky appeals to US lawmakers for answers as White House turns on Kyiv
items.teaser: "We want to understand what is happening, why it's happening, and where all this is heading," Zelensky told a bipartisan group of U.S. senators and representatives.

items.title: US senator calls on SpaceX to explain who restricted Starlink in Ukraine and why
items.teaser: Democratic Senator Chris Coons has requested details from SpaceX on who imposed operational limits on Starlink terminals used by Ukrainian defence forces.

items.title: Russian shelling in Kherson region injures child as forces attack over 20 settlements in past 24 hours

items.title: Reuters: Kushner and Witkoff to travel to Norway for Ukraine talks

items.title: Zaporizhzhia region provides military with equipment worth nearly UAH 40M

items.title: Zelensky holds online meeting with bipartisan delegation of U.S. Congress

items.teaser: Donald Trump has criticised Volodymyr Zelenskyy over efforts to end Russia's war against Ukraine, claiming the Ukrainian president should have secured a deal long ago. Trump also praised Xi Jinping and Russia for what he described as restraint towards Ukraine.
